title: MyCulture: Exploring Malaysia’s Diverse Culture under Low-Resource Language Constraints

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on the MyCulture benchmark, which consists of 2,652 questions covering six pillars of Malaysian culture (arts, attire, customs, entertainment, food, and religion) to assess their cultural alignment and comprehension of underrepresented local norms.

Comparing LLM performance on the same cultural questions using prompts in different languages (Malay, English, and Chinese) to measure disparities in accuracy and knowledge retrieval tied to the prompt's language.

Comparing model accuracy on traditional closed-form multiple-choice questions versus novel open-ended formats (multi-answer, ordering, and matching without predefined options) to quantify how much standard MCQ formats artificially inflate perceived model capabilities.
